title: Patient Hardship Discount Program Revocation and Reversal of Discounts
content:
## Revocation

R1. A Patient Hardship Discount Program determination is revoked when the business office finds that the application misstated income or household. The determination's status becomes *revoked*, with the reason and the date of revocation.

R2. On revocation, every discount granted under the determination within the revocation look-back — 365 calendar days before the revocation — is reversed for the reason *revoked for misrepresentation*, and the charges are owed again.

R3. A determination is never revoked on the patient's request; the patient may simply stop using it.

## Reversal on a later insurance payment

R4. Where the level reverses discounts on insurance payment, a later insurance payment on a discounted charge reverses the discount by the amount the insurer paid, never more than the discount, for the reason *insurance paid the charge*.

## The discount account

R5. The discount granted under a determination is the total of the discounts applied to the patient's charges under it, net of reversals. A reversal records the date, the discount reversed, the amount reversed and the reason.

## Worked cases (hypothetical amounts and dates)

| Case | Discount on the charge | Insurer later pays | Amount reversed | Discount remaining on the charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insurer pays less than the discount | $45.00 | $30.00 | $30.00 | $15.00 |
| Insurer pays more than the discount | $45.00 | $60.00 | $45.00 (never more than the discount) | $0.00 |

- **Revocation reach.** A determination is revoked on 2026-09-30. A discount granted under it on 2026-02-01, 241 calendar days earlier, is within the 365-day look-back and is reversed; that charge is owed again.
- **Patient no longer wishes to use the determination.** The determination is not revoked for that reason; the patient may simply stop using it.
